name: Reboot Addons
author: Miguel Carneiro

sections.description:
Reboot Addons is a toolkit for the parts of a WordPress site that normally need custom code: the sections people remember, forms that match the page, a login screen that looks like your brand, and the small settings that slow a site down.

It was built for real client sites, so everything is switch-on-what-you-use. Turn off any widget or tweak you don’t need and its code isn’t loaded.

The free version is complete on its own. There are no trial timers, no locked controls and no watermarks.

7 Elementor widgets

  • 3D Carousel – a rotating image carousel with real perspective depth and optional floor reflections. Made for portfolios, products and hero sections.
  • 3D Vertical Carousel – the same 3D depth effect, turned on its side for tall layouts and side columns.
  • Card Slider – swipeable image-and-text cards with navigation dots built in, for your own content or your posts.
  • Reboot Menu – a fully styleable header and footer menu with off-canvas and full-screen mobile menus, so you don’t need a separate menu plugin.
  • Content Fade Reveal On Scroll – a two-column storytelling section. As visitors scroll the text, the image beside it fades to match each paragraph.
  • Business Hours – a clean opening-hours table with highlighted weekend rows and ready-made colour schemes. Ideal for local businesses.
  • Elementor Back Button – a back button or link that takes visitors to the page they came from, styled like any Elementor button.

6 form stylers – keep your form plugin, lose the default look

Each styler is an Elementor widget. Pick your form, choose a preset, then fine-tune it visually. No CSS required.

  • Gravity Forms
  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Ninja Forms
  • SureForms
  • Forminator

Style the parts of the form that usually take custom CSS: fields, labels, descriptions, buttons, focus states, validation errors, success messages, borders, radius, shadows, spacing, typography and responsive layout. Every styler comes with a library of ready-made presets, so you can start from a finished design and adjust from there.

Login Stylizer – design your wp-login.php screen

A dedicated visual editor for the WordPress login page, with a live preview as you work. It’s not a logo field with two colour pickers.

  • Branding – your logo, with its size, shape and shadow.
  • The form – background colour, frosted-glass blur and transparency, borders, radius and shadow.
  • The page behind it – a solid colour, gradient, image, self-hosted HTML5 video or YouTube video, with a colour or gradient overlay.
  • Fields and button – inputs, labels, focus states and the submit button.
  • Typography – any Google Font, or keep your system font.
  • Details – entrance animations, footer text and social links, custom error messages and error styling. You can also hide the “Lost password” and “Back to site” links.
  • Security and flow – optional Google reCAPTCHA v2 or v3, a default for “Remember me”, and login redirects.

Five starter themes are included (Midnight SaaS, Aurora Glass, Clean Corporate, Black Tie and Warm Studio). Load one, make it yours, save it.

The Login Stylizer and the tweaks below work without Elementor.

Features & Tweaks – switch off what gets in the way

One-click toggles that replace a handful of snippet plugins. Each one does a single job.

WooCommerce

  • Change the shop and category “Add to cart” button to a “View product” link, with your own button text.
  • Clean pricing: trim the .00 from whole-number prices.

Performance

  • Remove the WordPress emoji scripts and styles.

Security

  • Disable XML-RPC.
  • Remove the WordPress version number from your page source.

Privacy & admin

  • Hide the admin bar for everyone except administrators.

Elementor clean-up

  • Hide Elementor’s upgrade promotions in the dashboard and editor.
  • Remove the “Created with Elementor” badge.

Reboot Addons Pro

Reboot Addons Pro is an optional yearly licence that adds:

  • 15 more Elementor widgets, including 3D Stacking Cards, Glow Cards, Playing Cards Effect, Advanced Text FX, Advanced Image FX, Advanced Slider, Product Hover Animation, Image Reveal Menu, App-Style Menu, Creative Overlay Menu and four more 3D carousel variants.
  • 20 more Login Stylizer themes, plus JSON import and export to reuse a login design on other sites.
  • 13 more tweaks for WooCommerce checkout and performance, the classic editor, and Elementor panel clean-up.

You can buy Pro from the “Go Pro” page in the plugin menu. Pro installs in place of the free version and keeps all your settings.

Built and supported by the developer

Reboot Addons is made by a working web developer, not a widget warehouse. You can send a support request, report a bug or ask for a new widget from Reboot Addons > Support inside WordPress. Many of the widgets exist because someone asked.

External services

Reboot Addons only connects to the services below, and only when you turn on the related feature.

Google reCAPTCHA (optional, off by default)
Used by the Login Stylizer to protect your login form. When you turn it on and enter your own site and secret keys, the login page loads Google’s reCAPTCHA script. When someone logs in, your server sends their reCAPTCHA response and IP address to Google for verification. Nothing is sent while reCAPTCHA is turned off.
Terms of use: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Fonts (optional)
If you choose a Google Font in the Login Stylizer, the login page loads that font’s stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com. The visitor’s browser then downloads the font from Google, which receives the visitor’s IP address. Nothing is loaded if you keep the default system font.
Terms of use: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

YouTube (optional)
If you choose a YouTube video as the Login Stylizer background, the login page embeds that video from youtube-nocookie.com (YouTube’s privacy-enhanced mode). The visitor’s browser connects to YouTube to play it. Nothing is loaded unless you choose a YouTube background.
Terms of service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Support requests by email (only when you send one)
The Reboot Addons > Support form uses your site’s own email system (wp_mail) to send your message to the developer. Each message includes your name, site URL, admin email address, the WordPress, PHP and Elementor versions, and any reference URL you enter. Nothing is sent unless you fill in the form and press send.
Privacy policy: https://rebootwebsites.co.za/privacy-policy/

Freemius (licensing and optional usage data)
Reboot Addons uses the Freemius SDK to handle Pro licences and updates. After activation you’re asked whether to share basic site and plugin usage data with Freemius. Nothing is sent unless you agree, and you can skip it. If you buy Pro, Freemius handles the checkout and licence activation.
Terms of service: https://freemius.com/terms/
Privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Reboot Addons”, then install and activate it. Alternatively, upload the reboot-addons folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it on the Plugins screen.
  2. Open Reboot Addons > Reboot Widgets to choose which widgets are switched on.
  3. Open Reboot Addons > Login Stylizer to design your login page, or Reboot Addons > Features to switch on tweaks.
  4. Edit any page with Elementor and look for the Reboot categories in the widget panel.

Elementor (free) is required for the widgets and form stylers. The Login Stylizer and Features & Tweaks work without it.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Everything works with the free version of Elementor, and it runs happily alongside Elementor Pro.

Do I need to replace my form plugin?

No. The form stylers style the forms you already have in Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, SureForms or Forminator. Your entries, notifications and integrations stay exactly as they are.

Will it slow my site down?

Each widget only loads its own CSS and JavaScript on pages where it’s used. Anything you switch off in Reboot Addons > Reboot Widgets isn’t loaded at all. Several of the tweaks exist purely to make sites lighter.

Will it work with my theme?

It’s built for Elementor’s flexbox containers and tested with Hello Elementor and block themes. It works with most well-made themes.

Can I use the Login Stylizer without Elementor?

Yes. The Login Stylizer and Features & Tweaks are standard WordPress admin screens and don’t need Elementor.

Where are the presets?

Login Stylizer themes are in Reboot Addons > Login Stylizer. Each form styler has its own Style Preset dropdown in the Elementor panel.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. Reboot Addons Pro is an optional yearly licence with 15 more widgets, 20 more login themes, login design import and export, and 13 more tweaks. See the “Go Pro” page in the plugin menu. The free version doesn’t depend on it.

I have an idea for a widget.

Send it through Reboot Addons > Support. You can include a link to an effect you’ve seen elsewhere.
sections.changelog:
1.1.15

  • Fix: minor bug fixes.

1.1.14

  • Fix: minor bug fixes.

1.1.13

  • Fix: fixed a rare bug where the Elementor editor could fail to load in some Elementor builds. Widget editor scripts now load more reliably.

1.1.11

  • Improvement: Text FX quality-of-life fixes. Character-split effects now keep words intact when text wraps, instead of breaking mid-word.

1.1.10

  • Minor bug fix.

1.1.8

  • First release on the WordPress.org directory.
  • Fix: explicit sanitize callbacks registered for widget toggle settings.
  • Content Fade Reveal rewritten as a dependency-free vanilla JS engine (100% GPL).

1.1.7

  • The plugin now deactivates itself with a notice on WordPress versions older than 6.4, instead of producing an error.

1.1.0

  • WordPress.org-ready release: the free version is fully functional with no locked features, all presets included, external assets bundled locally, and the text domain aligned with the plugin slug.
